∀ {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ),
  1 ≤ R →
    ∀ (V : Fin n → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ (i : Fin n), ContinuousOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0) ∧ MonotoneOn (V i) (Set.Ici 0)) →
        ∀ (j : ℕ),
          OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => V i t / 4) R j < ⊤ →
            (∀ k < j * R,
                OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.completionEvent V k
                    (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.completionEvent V)
                        k).starts ≠
                  none) ∧
              ENNReal.ofReal
                  (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.completionEvent V)
                      (j * R)).clock ≤
                OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => V i t / 4) R j

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (L sigma gamma : ℝ),
  0 < L →
    (∀ (x : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) →
      (∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
        LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g
            sigma →
          0 ≤ gamma →
            gamma ≤ 1 / (2 * L) →
              ∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun b => f (x - gamma • g y b)) ↑μ ∧
                  ∫ (b : Ω), f (x - gamma • g y b) ∂↑μ ≤
                    f x - gamma / 2 * ‖gradient f x‖ ^ 2 - gamma / 4 * ‖gradient f y‖ ^ 2 +
                        gamma * L ^ 2 / 2 * ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 +
                      gamma ^ 2 * L / 2 * sigma ^ 2

  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω) (L sigma gamma : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
  (a : ℕ → ℕ),
  0 < L →
    (∀ (x : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) →
      (∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
        LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g
            sigma →
          LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ ↑μ ↑P →
            (∀ (k : ℕ), a k ≤ k) →
              0 ≤ gamma →
                gamma ≤ 1 / (2 * L) →
                  ∀ (k : ℕ),
                    ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                        f (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (k + 1)) ∂↑P ≤
                      ∫ (ω : Ξ), f (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k) ∂↑P -
                              gamma / 2 *
                                ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                                  ‖gradient f
                                        (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω)
                                          k)‖ ^
                                    2 ∂↑P -
                            gamma / 4 *
                              ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                                ‖gradient f
                                      (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω)
                                        (a k))‖ ^
                                  2 ∂↑P +
                          gamma * L ^ 2 / 2 *
                            ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                              ‖OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k -
                                    OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a k)‖ ^
                                2 ∂↑P +
                        gamma ^ 2 * L / 2 * sigma ^ 2

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω Ξ : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω) (L sigma gamma : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
  (a : ℕ → ℕ),
  0 < L →
    (∀ (x : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) →
      (∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
        LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g
            sigma →
          LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ ↑μ ↑P →
            (∀ (k : ℕ), a k ≤ k) →
              ∀ (k : ℕ),
                (Measurable fun ω => OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k) ∧
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable
                      (fun ω => ‖OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k‖ ^ 2) ↑P ∧
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                        (fun ω =>
                          ‖gradient f (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k)‖ ^
                            2)
                        ↑P ∧
                      MeasureTheory.Integrable
                        (fun ω => f (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k)) ↑P

declarations.type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω Ξ : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω) (L sigma eps lower : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
  (a : ℕ → ℕ) (R K : ℕ),
  0 < L →
    0 ≤ sigma →
      0 < eps →
        (∀ (x : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) →
          (∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
            (∀ (x : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), lower ≤ f x) →
              LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f
                  g sigma →
                LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ ↑μ ↑P →
                  (∀ (k : ℕ), a k ≤ k) →
                    (∀ (k : ℕ), k < a k + R) →
                      8 * ↑R * L * (f x0 - lower) / eps + 16 * sigma ^ 2 * L * (f x0 - lower) / eps ^ 2 ≤ ↑K →
                        1 / (↑K + 1) *
                            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
                              ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                                ‖gradient f
                                      (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g
                                        (LongTails.Setups.RingmasterIterations.stepSize L sigma eps R) a x0
                                        (fun i => ξ i ω) k)‖ ^
                                  2 ∂↑P ≤
                          eps

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω Ξ : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω) (L sigma gamma lower : ℝ)
  (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (a : ℕ → ℕ) (R : ℕ),
  0 < L →
    (∀ (x : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) →
      (∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
        (∀ (x : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), lower ≤ f x) →
          LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g
              sigma →
            LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ ↑μ ↑P →
              (∀ (k : ℕ), a k ≤ k) →
                (∀ (k : ℕ), k < a k + R) →
                  0 < gamma →
                    gamma ≤ 1 / (2 * ↑R * L) →
                      ∀ (K : ℕ),
                        1 / (↑K + 1) *
                            ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
                              ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                                ‖gradient f
                                      (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k)‖ ^
                                  2 ∂↑P ≤
                          2 * (f x0 - lower) / (gamma * (↑K + 1)) + 2 * gamma * L * sigma ^ 2

declarations.type_text:
∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω Ξ : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω) (L sigma gamma : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
  (a : ℕ → ℕ),
  0 < L →
    (∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g
          sigma →
        LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ ↑μ ↑P →
          (∀ (k : ℕ), a k ≤ k) →
            ∀ (b m : ℕ),
              b ≤ m →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable
                    (fun ω =>
                      ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico b m,
                            (g (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a j))
                                (ξ j ω) -
                              gradient f
                                (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a j)))‖ ^
                        2)
                    ↑P ∧
                  ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                      ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico b m,
                            (g (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a j))
                                (ξ j ω) -
                              gradient f
                                (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a j)))‖ ^
                        2 ∂↑P ≤
                    (↑m - ↑b) * sigma ^ 2

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (sigma : ℝ),
  LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g sigma →
    ∀ (y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun b => ‖g y b‖ ^ 2) ↑μ ∧ ∫ (b : Ω), ‖g y b‖ ^ 2 ∂↑μ ≤ sigma ^ 2 + ‖gradient f y‖ ^ 2

∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω Ξ : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ξ] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ)
  (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω)
  (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ξ) (ξ : ℕ → Ξ → Ω) (L sigma gamma : ℝ) (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d)
  (a : ℕ → ℕ),
  0 < L →
    (∀ (x : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), HasGradientAt f (gradient f x) x) →
      (∀ (x y : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d), ‖gradient f x - gradient f y‖ ≤ L * ‖x - y‖) →
        LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f g
            sigma →
          LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID ξ ↑μ ↑P →
            (∀ (k : ℕ), a k ≤ k) →
              ∀ (k : ℕ),
                ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                    ‖OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) k -
                          OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a k)‖ ^
                      2 ∂↑P ≤
                  2 * (↑k - ↑(a k)) * gamma ^ 2 *
                      ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (a k) k,
                        ∫ (ω : Ξ),
                          ‖gradient f
                                (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.delayedIterate g gamma a x0 (fun i => ξ i ω) (a j))‖ ^
                            2 ∂↑P +
                    2 * (↑k - ↑(a k)) * gamma ^ 2 * sigma ^ 2

    (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R event k).count = k

declarations.name: OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing_invariant
declarations.type_text:
∀ {n : ℕ} (R : ℕ),
  1 ≤ R →
    ∀ (event : ℕ → (Fin n → ℝ) → Option (Fin n × ℝ)) (k : ℕ),
      (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R event k).count ≤ k ∧
        ∀ (i : Fin n),
          (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R event k).iters i ≤
              (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R event k).count ∧
            (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R event k).count <
              (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.timing R event k).iters i + R

∀ (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params),
  (0 < p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧ ∀ (i : Fin p.n), OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.PowerAssumption (p.power i)) →
    ∀ (I : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Instance p.d)
      (O :
        OracleTemplate.Oracle
          (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p))
          (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.Reply (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p))),
      outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.admissible p I O →
        OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => OracleTemplate.RennalaUniform.work (p.power i) t / 4)
              (max 1 ⌈p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε⌉₊) ⌈48 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε⌉₊ <
            ⊤ →
          let q := outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p;
          outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.successful p I
            (fun z =>
              OracleTemplate.execute O (OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.ringmaster q)
                (fun x => outputs.Algorithms.RingmasterTuning.timeHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ) z.1 z.2)
            ⟨(↑((OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd.ringmaster q).law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1), ⋯⟩
